verses.text: This is the message that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
"This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Write in a book all the words I have spoken to you.

For look, the days are coming,' says the LORD, 'when I will bring my people Israel and Judah back from captivity,' says the LORD. 'I will bring them back to the land I gave their ancestors, and they will own it.'"
These are the words the LORD spoke about Israel and Judah.
This is what the LORD says: "We hear cries of terror, of fear, not of peace.
Ask and see: can a man give birth to a child? Then why do I see every strong man holding his stomach like a woman in labor? Why has every face turned pale?
How terrible that day will be! There will be no other like it. It will be a time of trouble for Jacob, but he will be rescued from it.
On that day," says the LORD of Armies, "I will break the yoke off their necks and tear off their chains. Foreigners will no longer make them slaves.
Instead they will serve the LORD their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.

So do not be afraid, Jacob my servant," says the LORD. "Do not be discouraged, Israel. For look, I will rescue you from far away, and your descendants from the land where they are captives. Jacob will come back and have peace and quiet. No one will make him afraid.

For I am with you to save you," says the LORD. "I will completely destroy all the nations where I scattered you, but I will not completely destroy you. I will correct you fairly, but I will not let you go unpunished."
This is what the LORD says: "Your injury cannot be healed. Your wound is very serious.
There is no one to plead your case, no bandage for your wound. You have no medicine to heal you.
All your lovers have forgotten you. They do not care about you. I have struck you as an enemy would, and punished you cruelly, because your guilt is so great and your sins so many.
Why do you cry out about your injury? Your pain cannot be healed. I have done these things to you because your guilt is so great and your sins so many.
But all who devour you will be devoured. All your enemies, every one of them, will go into exile. Those who rob you will be robbed. All who attack you will be attacked.
For I will make you healthy again and heal your wounds," says the LORD, "because they have called you an outcast, saying, 'This is Zion, whom no one cares about.'"

This is what the LORD says: "Look, I will bring Jacob's people back from captivity and have compassion on their homes. The city will be rebuilt on its ruins, and the palace will stand in its proper place.
Songs of thanks and the sound of celebration will come from them. I will make them grow in number, and they will not be few. I will honor them, and they will not be looked down on.
Their children will be as they were long ago. Their community will be established before me, and I will punish all who oppress them.
Their leader will be one of their own. Their ruler will come from among them. I will bring him near, and he will come close to me. For who would dare come close to me on his own?" says the LORD.
"So you will be my people, and I will be your God."
Look, the storm of the LORD will burst out in fury, a sweeping storm swirling down on the heads of the wicked.
The LORD's fierce anger will not turn back until he has fully carried out the plans of his heart. In the days to come you will understand this.
